reviews.text:
We got absolutely exceptional experience  at this vet clinic. Special thanks to vet doctor Nataliia! She made a professional check up for my cat. She is very careful, expertised and attentive to the animal. I have gotten a lot of great  suggestions on my cat's health.
Also the receptionist was very nice and kind. Thank you!
Been coming to these guys for years.Friendly staff and reception is awesome . Always attentive and very helpful .

From the very first phone call, the staff at Killarney Animal Hospital were so kind and sweet. I was really worried about davante and they rushed him in right away, which meant everything to me.

Everyone was incredibly caring, compassionate and reassuring. They took such good care of him and made a stressful situation feel so much easier. I was also so impressed by how affordable they are. It is honestly rare to find a veterinary clinic that is this kind, this professional and this reasonably priced.

I absolutely loved my experience here and will definitely be bringing davante back. I’m so grateful I found them and would highly recommend Killarney Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares.
Best clinic! I bring my hamsters here. The doctor and staff are extremely kind and friendly. Oliver is the best, too.
Dr. D. Okeefe is the best and so is Jas the animal tech. So attentive and kind! Highly recommend.

I’ve been taking my cats here for years. With my first kitten, Kaya, her spay went well and I still take her here for all exams and vaccines. With my new kitten, Mio, she recently got spayed and they checked on how she was doing and answered any questions I had. Super affordable and great staff.

I have been taking my puppy to Killarney Animal Hospital since August 2019 (my puppy was 10 weeks old).
I can't tell the details, but the diagnosis for my dog was really suspicious and unclear. We took my puppy 3 times in a short period with the same symptoms; they couldn't figure out what it was, and it was the wrong diagnosis... now, after 3 months, my puppy is finally fine.
When I try to make an appointment thru shitty website "book an appointment " form, it never worked(I tried 2 different times). It seemed its went through,but nobody never respond. Then I made phone calls,sometimes nobody answered,which is fine they were busy at that moment,but automation message says "leave a message " also says "make this call emergency(urgent) press #"  yes there is option. Usually someone call me back within a day or next day, but this time nobody respond email (one week)or calls me back(4 days), then I phoned them and asked someone (who says she works 7 years there) why this would happened? The answer is online system is not connected their system....then why don't you close it down!!!??? Also she said , "we don't have voice mail,I work here for seven years here, but we never had voice mail system." weird....Then why I was able to leave a message and then I've got call back last 2 times ?? if like you say, you don't have voice mail system then how come did I get call back?? I thought they can't/won't apologize, so just made up the reason why they don't response. I requested to send a medical record of my puppy, we have to change the vet.
Good dental care here! 100% recommended!

Killarney animal hospital targets the all-giving pet-loving owners. Tale as old as time, charging for what they can get away with.

I called the clinic to see when my pet was due for her second round of vaccines, then I booked for the recommended date. When we arrive, the vet says it’s actually better to vaccinate in 1.5 weeks. I had thought it was nice of them to not administer an unnecessary vaccine and thanked her and got my pet the deworming medication instead. Come time to pay, $100 due, $45 of it being a exam fee; she checked my pets ears and teeth for precisely 30 seconds and I waited for room, next doctor, next doctor, medicine for the remaining 45 minutes of my visit.

So I paid $45 for a totally unnecessary appointment that the staff set for me. The conspiracy here is that they make early unnecessary appointments to charge you for their “exam” fee. Shame, I won’t be coming here ever again; I’ve found a clinic that would never overcharge.
Front desk lady is very rude

We need to drive 45min to here but we would rather driver far to here. The doctor is efficient and professional. Their price is reasonable compared the hospitals I asked in Coquitlam. (After failing to do x-ray and further treatment in Coquitlam, we rushed to be here on Saturday at 5:30pm. The doctor reacts fast upon exam and treatment. If I listens to the doctor in Coquitlam, I need to go to emergency for a price of  $3600-5000. Thanks Killarney saving my cat’s life.

I had an unfortunate experience dealing with an obnoxious rude disrespectful nasty woman that started to yell at me after I phoned several times to speak with the tech.
Hence I left several messages and emails to speak with the doctor with no return calls whatsoever. Absolutely pathetic customer service and attitude.
Furthermore, I was assured many times that the doctor would call me. Nothing but bare faced lies from the whole disgusting disfunctional lying clinic.
Buyer beware unless you want to be yelled at and disrespected and hung up on and ripped off.

Happy to have switched to a much better clinic.  Doctor David is very thorough and compassionate I see as he took time to explain things, give us a rundown, managed our expectations all in a very calm and caring manner. Gives me so much hope for my dog. Staff has been great too since my first phone call inquiry.
I went in specifically for vaccinaton. They added a deworming charge without my consent; it wasn't explained. Also, customer service could be improved.

I had a very disappointing experience at this veterinary clinic while trying to prepare my dog’s international travel documents.

The day before my appointment, I went to the clinic and explained that I needed health certificate paperwork completed. The receptionist told me she could book me for the next day, and at no point did she mention that my dog needed to be present at the appointment. Since I was only bringing paperwork, I naturally came alone the next day.

At the appointment, they suddenly asked questions about additional vaccines and then informed me that my dog was required to be there. When I politely asked why nobody told me this the day before, the receptionist insisted she had already explained it. I responded that if she truly had, I obviously would have brought my dog. That is when the attitude started.

While speaking with the veterinarian, the vet left the room to “check something.” Then the receptionist came in and started asking me the exact same questions again. I explained that I had already gone over all of this information. She immediately became rude, rolling her eyes and making dismissive facial expressions while speaking to me. When I reacted the same way back, she laughed. I asked, “What’s funny?” and she suddenly raised her voice at me and walked out of the room.

After that, nobody properly informed me about my dog’s travel requirements or paperwork process.

The most concerning part is that they seemed completely uninformed about international pet travel documentation. I later learned from another veterinarian that only one copy of the paperwork is completed by the clinic, while the remaining copies are finalized by the CFIA/government veterinarian for endorsement. This clinic could not even clearly explain how many documents were required.

The appointment process was also extremely disorganized and time-consuming. I arrived at 3:25 PM and did not leave until 4:40 PM,  they just needed to fill out the 1 form and 2 of the copies of the same paper. They just had to check and write it down same things how can it take 1 hour to fill it out 1 page of 3 forms
??!! From approximately 3:25 to 3:45, I was simply waiting in the examination room with my dog, without any updates or communication from the staff. My dog was crying non stop he had anxiety too. If I am priceless for them as a human if the dog is very important why don’t you comfy my pet first than ? No one informed me about delays or what was happening.

It honestly felt like the staff were avoiding the situation. The veterinarian seemed nervous and unsure, which gave me very little confidence that they knew how to properly handle international travel paperwork. After an argument with the receptionist, who laughed during the interaction instead of addressing my concerns professionally, I was left sitting alone from 4:00 to 4:40 with no explanation and no assistance from any staff member.

In the end, I left the clinic without receiving proper information or guidance because no one came back to speak with me. They called me 7 minutes later after I left. Overall, this was a very frustrating and unprofessional experience.

Meanwhile, they were prepared to charge me nearly $400 just to fill out paperwork — approximately $125 + tax per page. 600 dollars for rabies’s titre test which is Canada not even in the list of risk for rabies. I already contacted with my country. I ve told the receptionist that FOR CANADA IT IS NOT REQUIRED. but they were just asking chat gpt to if its true or not.

If you are planning to travel internationally with your pet, I would strongly recommend going somewhere with actual experience handling export documents and better customer service.
They took amazing care of my fur baby  Cosmos. Will recommend them. Will be having my dog in also soon. Wonderful staff.

Highly recommend this clinic! Dr. David O'Keefe  and Jess are incredibly patient and caring. They didn't just treat my cat Bagel; they looked after me too with encouraging words and comfort. I feel so supported here."

Brought my kitten in to get his vaccines. Front desk was super helpful and kind. We didn't have to wait very long for the vet. Dr. David was also very kind and took time to answer all our questions. Will be bringing our kitten back for all his needs.

Recently had my 4 year old morkie’s teeth cleaned here. Wonderful experience, friendly and professional staff and reasonably priced. Looking forward to using this clinic as our new primary care provider for our dog going forward.

This clinic is amazing. My dog had a traumatic injury last night when we were nearby this clinic - she is not an existing patient and it was already 6 PM, and yet they were able to get her into surgery right away.

The vet and staff were kind, professional, efficient, and informative - everything you could ask for. Killarney Animal Hospital absolutely saved the day and I would highly recommend this clinic. Thank you so much, Roo and I are so grateful.

We've been bringing our senior dog to this clinic for over 13 and half years, since he was a puppy. He had this neutering and all his vaccines done here, and the care has always been excellent. Even though we live in Surrey, we continue to make the drive because we trust them completely.
Dr. David O'keefe is very compassionate and truly cares about his patients. The staff are kind, professional, and the prices are very reasonable. We are very grateful for the care they've given our dog throughout his life. Highly recommended!
Great place, fast, friendly, and reasonably priced. Brought a cat in for checkup, and treated with respect and kindness.
It was an easy pleasant visit at this vet. They we friendly and took the time to explain everything to us. Great value here too.

Feb 12 2026- Waited 10 mins watching the lady at the front counter upcharge this poor cat owner so much so that I had to step in and say something to advocate for her. The lady asked to please not share her kennel with other cats and animals like they did last time. Her poor cat was stressed out because another cat was in her home. It doesnt seem like this place understands basic animal care. How this lady could leave her pet there is boyond me, she was not happy about the 750 in upcharges the lady at the front desk tried to hustle out of her.

It came time for me to grab my bag of dog food from a place I would never return to and be off! Nope, this fine young lady refused to sell it to me unless I gave her my name, email, phone number, work number, address, postal code, and on an on. I begged to please expedite the process and to figure out a work around and in the end she refused to sell me "prescription" 😂 dog food. I have never seen a business refuse to sell something before. Its just plain rediculous.

I gave 3 Stars because I am fair and I am sure the poor owner of this place had no idea what was going on.  Hopefully the customer service gets better at this place but from my assessment, red flags were popping off the minute I walked in. Its a reputable valued community vet clinic that has been serving Vancouver for 2 decades. Great news.  I think I will add another star just for that.

Peace of mind for pet owners:

Founded in 1998 by Dr. Parminder Mangat (DVM, designated veterinarian per BC's College of Veterinarians), it remains locally owned and operated by him as of February 2026, focusing on multispecialty care for dogs, cats, and small exotics like ferrets and guinea pigs.

**ATTEN ALL**

We were looking for a new vet for our cat’s neutering surgery. We used to go to a clinic in Port Moody, but since surgery can be tiring for pets, we wanted somewhere closer to home.

I called this clinic to ask about neutering details and pricing. The receptionist quoted $200 + tax/fees. I also asked whether a comprehensive blood test would be required since this would be our first visit. I was told it wasn’t necessary as long as the cat was healthy, which already felt like an odd response. At that time I didn’t have my work schedule yet, so I said I would call back to book.

Two days later (July 10, Saturday at 6:50pm), my husband called to schedule the appointment. Based on the previous call, we expected the price to be around $200 + tax, but a different receptionist told us it would be $300 + tax/fees. When we politely asked why the price was different and why we were given inconsistent information, she simply said:
“It doesn’t matter. I just checked our price list and it’s $300 plus taxes/fees.”

We completely understand that miscommunication can happen and that pricing may vary. However, the tone and professionalism were very disappointing. Accurate information should be given to clients, especially when discussing medical procedures and costs. Clients have the right to understand pricing clearly.

What was most upsetting was the attitude during the call. We were put on hold without explanation, and at one point the receptionist even said, in a mocking tone, that if we were looking for something cheaper we should “go to the BCSPCA.” We never asked for a discount. Our concern was simply the inconsistency in information and clarity of pricing. We care about the quality of care for our pet first and foremost.

If pricing depends on weight or other factors, that should be explained clearly from the beginning. No one mentioned that during either call.

I’m sharing this experience for anyone considering switching to this clinic. We decided not to proceed and will look for a clinic that communicates more clearly and treats clients with professionalism and respect.

brought in our goldendoodle and pomeranian today for vaccines and checkups. dr. david o’keeffe was really patient, answered all our questions, and was very gentle and kind with both dogs. he was attentive and made us feel comfortable and trusting of the care. the receptionists and assistants were also friendly and helpful. overall a great experience. will be booking again with dr. david.
Nice greeter 😘 …
Excellent

Brought my dog in with a UTI and had a really good experience. Was able to get a day of appointment. She usually gets really overstimulated at the vet, but with Dr. O’Keefe, she was the calmest she’s ever been at the vet before. She usually takes calming medications before going to the vet, but because of the rushed appointment, she wasn’t on any medication. Yet the vet was able to calm her down really quickly. Both the vet and all of the people who work as assistants were great to deal with and very friendly. Overall, really positive experience.

I've been going to this vet for years. The best part of this office is his vet tech and assistant Christine. She is so knowledgeable and kind and caring. And this office you can get in anytime . They are very flexible!

I would give 0 if there is an option. It’s such a rip off.  My cat need total 84 days of medication for FIP.  The vet told me he would only prescribe me 30days of meds.  I will have to pay for a blood test which costs hundreds of dollars.  Otherwise he won’t give me the rest of the prescription. On top of that. Each time he prescribe me medication would charge an additional $70 for prescription fee. Going to make complaints to the board. Those vet are all about making money from desperate pet owners !  No hearts about saving life!
Super friendly, kind and fast services

I spent a month in Vancouver and visited a large veterinary clinic there. To my dismay, I encountered an Indian veterinarian who treated us Asians with disrespect and condescension. How could such a renowned clinic employ such a doctor?

The doctor was rude. After his treatment, they gave the impression that everything is ok (even after I asked multiple times to make sure), then my cat died on the same night.

When confronted the doctor after that, he kept insulting my english by saying I misunderstood him, and turned to my friend and tell him to explain to me. Then when my friend asked him too, he then said we both misunderstood him. Then he even mentioned that “EVERYONE COME FROM DIFFERENT CULTURE”

They just want to grab more money that’s why they held my cat there, causing my cat to not have the right treatment and died.

NOT EVEN AN APOLOGIZE, BUT KICKED US OUT WHEN WE CONFRONTED (PEACEFULLY OF COURSE)
Very friendly and informative.
Very thorough.

My cat was going in and out of the litter box non stop and wasn’t peeing for about 2days so I took him to Killarney animal hospital. I had to leave my cat at the vet so they can take a urine sample. they found crystal in his pee and called me to ask if I’m ok with him doing an xray to check his bladder.
Dr explained to me well and prescribed 14days medication and urine diet plan. It worked very well and my cat had stopped going in and out of the litter box in about 2days after medication.

This place charge a very reasonable price. They dont even charge consultation fee if you’re taking your pets for vaccination.

Very good dr
Beautiful hospital and beautiful cats. And Dr. Christine is one of the most insomnia people in the treatment. Nice. Pill. Thanks for this experience with you. Sterilize my son Shadow.

Unfortunately, I was not satisfied with the visit. After my dog had diarrhea, she became weak and lethargic, but instead of doing basic diagnostics (checking mucous membranes, temperature, blood test), the doctor immediately ordered an X-ray, which showed nothing. As a result, time and money were wasted.

Went to get our large breed dog's infected hot spot treated, they were really great start to finish. Vet did the exam, told us what he suspected and said he'll try to do the cut and clean without sedation first but will call if sedation is necessary. They were done in about 15 minutes-no sedation was required and we were sent home with ointment and antibiotics. The bill was very reasonable and we even got a call following up on how he's doing one week later which adds more of a personal touch!

This pet hospital killed my cat they gave him a shot And after the shot, my cat had some breathing problems and then today he passed away and I don’t even know what kind of shot they gave him. He spent 500 something they told us it was antibiotics but maybe they gave him something wrong.💔 …

10/10 service. The receptionists are very awesome, i changed my schedule 3 times in 2 days but they all still try to accommodate me. All the docs are super patience and nice towards everyone and their pets as well. They have very competitive price as well.

Not very good paid $525 for my cat for bloodwork and to treat his skin condition but they said they would call me back the next day I called today and they said they had the report blood work done and it’s ready and they’ll call me back and I still never got the call back

This small locally owned and operated practice really cares about your beloved animals.  And the  Vets provide exemplary expert veterinary care while the vet techs  offer the most compassionate customer service.  We love them and know that Doodles our cat is in very good hands!!!

Highly recommend Killarney Animal Hospital! Great care for my pet's teeth treatment. Dr. Mani was very skilled in his job. Christina and Jas were super friendly and helpful too. Thanks for taking good care of my pet.

100/100 Experience – Thank You, Killarney Vet Hospital!

I brought my dog for the first time to Killarney Vet Hospital for his first dental cleaning, and I cannot say enough good things about the entire experience. My pup is normally extremely anxious at any vet and I usually have to pre-drug him but didn’t this time since he was going to be under sedation—he usually starts shaking the moment we even pull into a parking lot.

From the moment we walked in, the clinic manager greeted us with such kindness, compassion, and genuine care. The clinic is extremely clean as well, which is something I look for. Floors were sparkling!  I was nervous all day, but receiving a reassuring call in the afternoon letting me know everything was going smoothly brought such relief.

When I came to pick him up, the front staff and vet techs told me he’d been relaxed, happy, and even playful with them all afternoon—something I never imagined hearing given how nervous he usually is. It was so heartwarming to see how loved and well cared for he was. They all said he was so sweet with them and gave them all lots of love. ❤️

I could tell he had a truly positive experience, and that speaks volumes about the level of care, patience, and love this team gives to their furry patients. He was relaxed and laying on the floor calmly when I was talking to the staff. That has NEVER happened before!

Thank you to every single person at Killarney Vet Hospital for making my baby Finn feel so comfortable and cared for.  You made something stressful feel easy, and I am so grateful. Highly, highly recommend.

— A very happy (and relieved!) dog mom 💛
Very good service!
These people saved my dogs life. I'm forever grateful. Thank you 🙏 …
Have been going there for over 5 years.  prices for check up are much better than most and service has improved over the years.
Great service from Dr Mangat and all the techs. Friendly and confident care

They always take great care of our 3 pets!   Thank you... #Kokanee #Garfield #Skywalker
Kokanee now 120.4 pounds!
I’ve been coming here for over 15 years, always  great with us and our cats, great team of veterinarians and nurses.
Looong time ago this very same hospital. Saved my pup from a raccoon attack ! just thankful that’s all.

This clinic is terrible. I came in on time only to find out the appointment was an hour later. They made me come in an hour early for no reason. What's worse was the attitude of Dr. Mangat. He's rude and arrogant. I brought in my foster cat for an echo and he sedated her only because they didn't have the skills to handle a nervous cat. He's well aware she's asthmatic. He lied to my face that he got the approval from the organization. He bluffed me he would talk to the founder of the organization if I don't cooperate. He wouldn't let me see the cat because I'm "only a foster" and he would need the approval of the organization to let me see the cat. I've reported him to the board for administering sedation without consent.
Took our standard poodle Kayla in to get 3 cysts removed and was an  excellent experience with  no issues whatsoever ,i highly recommended Killarney animal hospital to  get this surgery for dogs !!!!
Amazing. All I can say. The staff the Vet the respect and care towards the pet and owners and how they are super informative. Love them will always go to them

I’ve been a loyal customer at this vet for 8 YEARS, but after what happened this week, I am beyond disappointed — I’m heartbroken and furious.

We brought in our healthy 4-year-old cat for a dental cleaning. The vet told us he needed 4 teeth removed. We trusted them. Big mistake.

Since the surgery, it’s been a nightmare. He didn’t eat for two days. We brought him back — they gave him meds and sent him home. Four days later, he suddenly couldn’t control his bladder, he was bleeding, and he vomited. We called in a panic — and were told the soonest they could see him was the next day at 12:30pm. Seriously?

I called again begging for help. The response? “The doctor’s gone for the day.” No urgency. No compassion. The receptionist was dismissive and completely unhelpful. I asked for my cat’s medical records so I could take him to an emergency vet. I was told there would be a $10 admin fee. Fine. But here we are — it’s 8:20pm, the clinic is closed, and I STILL haven’t received the records.

We’ve spent $1600 this week at this clinic. And when our cat is clearly suffering — possibly dying — this is the kind of treatment we get? No follow-up. No support. No accountability.

This clinic has lost all of my trust. After 8 years, I will never bring any of my pets here again. Shame on you for treating a loyal client and a suffering animal this way.

The vet never returned our call and we called in the next day to cancel the 12:30pm appointment.  Really bad experience.
They help me a lot with my dog and they were pretty honest with her diagnose I will recommend it 100%

I recently took my pet for a vaccination at killanery animal hospital with Dr. Navdeep Singh Khinda, and the experience was absolutely terrible. He injected my dog in an extremely rough, unprofessional, and unethical manner. My poor dog was in severe pain for three days, crying and refusing to let me pick him up. It was heartbreaking to see him suffer like that.

When I took him back to get checked, instead of taking responsibility, Dr. Khinda just gave him a painkiller and tried to shift the blame onto my dog, which was completely unacceptable. Due to the incorrect injection, my dog developed swelling at the injection site, yet they acted like it was nothing.

I also consulted the clinic’s main doctor, P. Mangat, and was equally disappointed. He seemed more focused on pushing unnecessary medications, including pre-medicines before vaccination, rather than actually caring for my pet’s health. His approach felt purely commercialized, as if money was the priority over my dog’s well-being.

Overall, my experience at this clinic was extremely disappointing, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone who genuinely cares about their pet.

These guys are true heros. Our 2 year old Shnauzer became suddenly violently ill during the night. By morning I could tell this was very serious. I called our usual (now former) vet first thing in the morning and was greeted by the receptionist who was rude and cold even after I explained that I thought she might be dying. I called Killarney Animal Hospital who were the next closest and right from the beginning were treated with kindness and care. Christina told us to bring her right in and she was examined by the most knowledgable Vet. They ran tests within an hour and found she may have been poissened. They kept her all day and literally saved her life. She is now healing at home nicely. Needless to say we will be coming here from now on. When you are as panicked as we were during this it is amazing how important it is to have people like this tending to your loved one. Thank you.

Willow’s spay at Killarney Animal Hospital was a great success! She has been recovering very quickly, and I couldn’t be happier with the care she received. The staff was incredibly attentive and made sure I had all the necessary information before and after the procedure. Their prices are affordable, and they truly care about their patients— they even called a few days later to check on her recovery. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and caring vet!
Dr. Mangat has treated our two French Bulldogs for past 2 years. Exceptional Veterinary services. Highly recommended.
Dr parmjit mangat is a very caring gentle vet he takes very good care of my dog each time we visit
Excellent care for both our French Bulldogs! Such careful attention to detail and my dogs always feel safe! Thank you Dr. Mangat!!!

This is not my regular vet and a bit of a drive for me, but they have much more reasonable prices for spay and neutering cats, and I had sibling rescues to be done… it was cost prohibitive at my regular vet, and I was able to get my cats in quickly, even scheduled for a Saturday which suits my work schedule, the staff were friendly, kind, and efficient and my kitties have healed up nicely and now have their microchips as well. All for less than half the cost at my regular nearby vet. Thank you very much Killarney animal Hospital!! I do believe we will be visiting you again in future!

called to ask for vaccine records and got nothing but a rude attitude because she was speaking to fast for me to be able to write down. for someone who is supposed to be working customer service i’ve never spoken to someone so rude.

From someone who worked in the industry for 4 years I cannot recommend this vet to anyone. I've never had an issue obtaining vaccine records.

For the most part this is a great clinic who has assisted our pets throughout the years.  My only arguement is when I brought my senior dog in she needed to be put down as she was suffering.  We knew this was her final moments and during this process the clinic instead of making her comfortable they went through the payment process and choosing her urn and cremation while she was dying on the table without euthanasia.  To this day it haunts me having to had watch her go the way she did.
I love Oliver he’s So cute, soft and handsome 🥰 …
I had an amazing experience here. But very expensive.

I had the best experience here!! My dog is 8 years old and 7lbs (chihuahua/Pomeranian). She was never spayed (I got her at 18yr old and didn’t really know better) I decided to get her spayed as she got her period after almost 2yrs of not having it and after some research and I decided it was best to spay her. Other places wanted to charge me 2-3x the amount I paid here. They also booked me an appointment right away for 2 days later. I was really worried about her age and spaying her so late in life and they were very kind and reassuring and I didn’t feel judged. When picking her up they told me she had pyometra and that it’s really good I got her spayed that day because it could have burst at any time which would have killed her. they showed me a picture and her uterus was 4x what it should be. They didn’t even charge me more for the spay even though at that point it would have been a more high risk surgery and most vets would have charged more. They were so great and educated me on vaccines as well. I really loved this vet, the whole experience was great and the front desk ladies were amazing. I will 100% be coming here for all future needs. Thank you guys for everything!! ❤️

The doctor here is so caring.  He understands the furmily and their situations.  It shows that they’re not trying to extend their services in able to generate more fees & costly/unnecessary expenses.  So grateful of you.  Thank you so much for all that you do.  ❤️🙏🏼 …

“I had an exceptional experience at the vet office today, thanks to Christine! From the moment I walked in, she was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. She made both me and my pet feel at ease with her kind demeanor and clear communication. Christine went above and beyond to ensure all my concerns were addressed, explaining everything thoroughly and patiently. Her genuine care and expertise stood out, making what could have been a stressful visit so much more manageable. I left feeling confident and happy !!
Thank you, Christine❤️‍🔥

I sent my kitten Rayne for spaying and impressed with the service received! The surgery was successful, and Rayne recovered perfectly from the evening of the same day! The charge was  very reasonable. The receptionists were friendly and helpful. Many thanks!

Our experience with Killarney Animal Hospital has been good in all the years we have taken our dog there. Dr. Mangat is thorough and explains everything very clearly and answers all our questions. The clinic always sends us a reminder when …
I love it! Doggie hates it
Dr. Parminder mangat is the most knowledgeable veterinarian in town. I can’t trust anyone else with my babies
